answer.reason: The adapter maps all seven KilnwisePhase values one-for-one onto renamed members (SCHEDULED->queued … FAULTED->broken), and no domain spec or glossary names these stages. The core also never uses the finer lines: it groups queued/drying together and lets queued, drying, heating and soaking fall through together in the switch, so the seven-way split comes from the vendor, not the domain.
